mutations.label: make a broken fetch exit ALARM, so breakage and alarm become indistinguishable to a triager
mutations.replace: return EXIT_ALARM  # same defect, sized to differ

mutations.label: let a reported GAP exit QUIET, so a run that admits it missed events still reads as all-clear
mutations.find: return EXIT_ALARM if (result.alarms or result.gap) else EXIT_QUIET
mutations.replace: return EXIT_ALARM if result.alarms else EXIT_QUIET

mutations.label: stop treating a corrupt state file as no-cursor, so the monitor tracebacks instead of re-baselining
swallow a gh failure and return no events, making a broken monitor look like all quiet
mutations.find: raise RuntimeError(f"gh api activity failed for {repo}: {detail}")
